title: Marketing Science Research and Partnerships Manager
searchText: Marketing Science Research and Partnerships Manager Reddit Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 121 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . We are looking for a Marketing Science Research and Partnerships Manager to lead a global, multi-disciplinary team. This newly created role will oversee both our Measurement Research group and our Third-Party (3P) Measurement Partnerships and Insights group. You will be an integral part of the Marketing Sciences team, driving our value proposition to agencies and brands by demonstrating the power and performance of Reddit as a media platform. In short, we’re looking for a visionary leader who can balance deep technical research with strategic partnership management. This role reports directly to the Senior Director, Global Marketing Science . Responsibilities Team Leadership & Development: Manage and develop a global team of data scientists and partnership managers, ensuring efficient operations and career growth within the Marketing Science function. Strategic Bets Oversight: Drive the execution of strategic bets including platform research & insights, 3P solutions enablement as well as scaled tooling & productivity solutions. Research & Methodology: Direct the development of various measurement methodologies, algorithms, and tools—such as attitudinal survey research, ROI measurement, and causal inference—to support global sales efforts. Partnership Management: Manage the implementation and activation of partner solution programs for clients, acting as the primary liaison between external 3P measurement partners and Reddit internal teams. Technical Informatics: Oversee a data informatics team focused on delivering technology-based solutions, including clean room implementations, AI tooling, and ML productivity. Insights & Narratives: Support the creation of 1P and 3P research, meta-analyses, and case studies that communicate Reddit’s value to internal and external stakeholders. Industry Representation: Represent Reddit to the larger research and analytics industry through speaking engagements, white papers, and conferences. Operational Excellence: Oversee project completion from initiation to delivery, ensuring all research and tooling scales across all Reddit advertisers. Who You Are Expert Leader: A seasoned manager with experience overseeing data science and research teams to leverage diverse data sources for actionable business insights. Minimum 3 years of team leadership experience. Quantitatively Rigorous: Advanced degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics or a similar quantitative discipline is preferred. Methodology Maven: Expertise in experimental and quasi-experimental design, with deep knowledge of advanced statistical methods and causal inference. Technically Savvy: Proficiency with big data technologies (SQL, Python, BigQuery) and familiarity with emerging AI/ML productivity tools. Strategic Communicator: Ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders and outside analytics teams. Adaptable & Innovative: Comfortable driving innovative research through ambiguity in a rapidly growing company environment. Benefits: Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs 401k with Employer Match Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support Family Planning Support Gender-Affirming Care Mental Health & Coaching Benefits Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off Generous Paid Parental Leave Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ . To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below. The base salary range for this position is: $194,600 — $272,400 USD In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. Reddit is a community of communities.
